headline: A 2018 executive order aimed at giving federal agency technology chiefs a stronger role in managing their agencies' information technology.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with Chief Information Officers (CIOs), the officials who oversee computer systems and technology at federal agencies. It aims to make these officials more effective in their jobs. No official summary was provided, so the specific rules and changes it sets are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Chief Information Officers at federal agencies
who_it_affects.how: The order is meant to change or strengthen how these officials do their jobs managing agency technology.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agency leaders and IT staff
who_it_affects.how: They may see changes in how technology decisions are made and managed within their agencies.
